_notice: Room-code prefixes supplied by the WayFinder team (not yet verified on site). mapName is the exact MapTiler dataset name each prefix was matched to; the app resolves it to the polygon at runtime. A prefix only says which building a code points to: it never confirms a room, and the floor is never inferred from the room number.
